title: Anna and the French Kiss
author: Stephanie Perkins
summary: A reluctant American teenager is sent to a boarding school in Paris for her last year of high school. She falls hard for a charming, taken classmate who has become her closest friend.
readIf: you want a sweet, tension-filled teen romance set in a vividly imagined Paris.
skipIf: you dislike the push and pull of unresolved feelings and a long wait for the pair to get together.

pairings.reason: Another charming, warm young adult romance with a likeable and self-doubting heroine.
A more bittersweet teen love story that deals with harder family circumstances.
A grown-up friends-to-lovers story that follows a similar yearning built over many shared trips.
